# Personalize repository documentation and community files

Before designing or implementing the new theme, replace starter-specific repository identity, contacts and ownership details. Use the new theme title, description and maintainer-approved contact information; do not copy the template's release history or assume its maintainers own the new theme.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is initialized for the new theme using [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), with an `Unreleased` section and only real changes or releases from this repository, not the template's history.
- [ ] `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `SECURITY.md` and `SUPPORT.md` describe the new theme where relevant, use the correct maintainer-approved contact email(s), and point to this repository rather than the starter for issues and support. Preserve the code of conduct's attribution and policy language when updating its contact details.
- [ ] `LICENSE` is reviewed for the intended license, correct copyright holder and year(s), while retaining any required upstream notices.
- [ ] `.github/CODEOWNERS` names valid owners of this repository rather than the template's owners.
- [ ] `.github/FUNDING.yml` is kept only if its funding links are appropriate for the new theme's maintainers; otherwise it is removed.
